card.name: Shell prompts and mid-command spots
card.fires_on: Shell prompt symbols (# or %) just before a Linux command, and odd spots inside technical text such as 'to' or 'the' in a sentence about software faults or function calls. Also digits inside numbers.

modes.label: Shell prompt before command
modes.description: The # or % prompt character right before a command such as ls or chattr in Linux security how-tos.

modes.label: Linking word in software text
modes.description: A small word like 'to' or 'the' in technical sentences about application faults or function calls.
modes.example: you'll need third-party systems management software to alert RepliStor<< to>> application faults.

modes.label: Digits inside numbers
modes.description: A digit or space within a number, such as a date or process ID.

card.plain: It fires on command-line prompts and a few small words or digits in computer-system text, not on medical content.
